caption: Let’s make this delicious meal Baby approved in 10 minutes -Preheat the oven to 400F -season wild caught salmon with olive oil lemon black pepper garlic powder paprika and herbs  -cook for 10minutes  -while it’s cooking, mash half avocado and spread it on a toast bread, add your favorite cheese - in a skillet on a medium heat, add butter and toast your bread until it’s golden brown  - cut the toast into strips and your salmon is ready by now  Simple but super nutritious 👶👶 #babyfood #babymeals #toddlermealideas #babyledweaning #babyrecipes
